code2='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    remaining = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background}
    components = []
    while remaining:
        start = remaining.pop()
        comp = {start}
        queue = [start]
        while queue:
            r, c = queue.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in remaining:
                    remaining.remove(q); comp.add(q); queue.append(q)
        components.append(comp)
    shape = max(components, key=len)
    rs = [r for r,c in shape]; cs = [c for r,c in shape]
    cr, cc = (min(rs)+max(rs))//2, (min(cs)+max(cs))//2
    markers = [p for comp in components if comp is not shape for p in comp]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers: out[r][c] = background
    for mr,mc in markers:
        for r,c in shape:
            rr,cc2 = mr+(r-cr), mc+(c-cc)
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc2 < w:
                out[rr][cc2] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
